text: twine taken from one boy, 13 pupils, a school coming apart. Nebraska, 1888. The door blew in, then the windows. Mini Freeman knew the building wouldn't last. The nearest house was three quarters of a mile away. She remembered the twine she'd taken from a boy playing in class. She tied the pupils together and waited. Only then did the roof blow away.
